name: cli-jev
description: cli-jev is the single public skill identity for Jev typed judgments: it routes a request to its cli-usage transport through mode-registry.json and hub-router.json, and holds no packet-local logic. The advisor sees one hub; the transport bridges the jev CLI and MCP surface, returns one typed value and never mutates this workspace.
trigger_examples: use jev choice to pick a queue
ask jev for a probability that this plan ships on time
score these three levels with jev
run a batch of typed questions through jev
what does the cli-jev hub do
